reason: I have one e-book and almost no sales yet, so the free plan with 1 page and 1 product is all I need. I'm not paying 9 900 FCFA a month before money is coming in, and I'd still have to check who is behind Maketia first.
objection: Another new platform nobody I know uses. Who is behind it? And I still have to confirm every payment by hand and send the link myself, so what am I paying for?
would_change_my_mind: Making real sales on the free plan, enough that I need more products, and seeing creators I follow in Abidjan or Dakar use it without problems.
